title: Признание в палате и одолжение санитару  (A Confession in the Ward and a Favor from the Orderly)

segments.t: Sitting by his bedside, Elena Pavlovna encourages Viktor Petrovich to take care of his health for the sake of his wonderful daughter—and for her own sake too. Once she steps out, a deeply moved Barinov calls the orderly over and asks him to do a quiet favor.
Вы должны бороться за эту жизнь.
Let's replay the exchange and look closely at each Russian phrase.
Вы должны бороться за эту жизнь.
'You must fight for this life.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'you' before landing on 'life'.
'You have such an amazing daughter.' Fedya brings out the contrast between 'by' and 'you' in a few short words. Senya answers right away.
'Do it for her sake.' The meaning hinges on 'come on' working together with 'her' in spoken Russian.
'Well, and for mine too.' Notice how Russian expresses 'come on' and 'me' with crisp inflection rather than helper words.
'I do not know.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'I' and finishing on 'know'. Fedya answers right away.
'I did not do anything.' Notice how Russian expresses 'I' and 'did' with crisp inflection rather than helper words.
'I did not taste anything.' The negative particle sits right before the verb meaning 'to try' to negate the statement.
'That is just, that is just...' The grammar packs 'this' and 'at all' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange. Senya answers right away.
'How can anyone lie like that?' The grammar packs 'how' and 'to lie' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'Calm down. Calm down.' In Russian, the idea of 'calm down!' flows naturally into 'calm down!' without extra filler words.
'I understand.' The meaning hinges on 'I' working together with 'understand' in spoken Russian. Fedya answers right away.
'I do not want to.' In Russian, the idea of 'I' flows naturally into 'want' without extra filler words.
'Do me a favor.' Senya anchors the line on 'make', while 'favour' completes the thought. Let's hear the complete conversation once more.
Вы должны бороться за эту жизнь.
